resolved_conflicts.explanation: A Medford Mail Tribune item from August 1916 refers to a guard on the lookout at Windy Peak, a year before the 1917 build date. The 1917 reports describe new construction, so the record keeps 1917. The 1916 mention is unexplained.
The register names Rogue River National Forest as administrator but says the tower was built for the Crater National Forest, as the 1917 reports also say. The story uses both names.
The register gives 4,933 ft (1,504 m). The National Geodetic Survey description on the Forest Lookouts page gives 4920 feet. The register figure is kept.

notes_for_editor: Record's built 1917 and gone status hold. No present-day description found in one search. The Lane County, Oregon Windy Peak (Siuslaw NF) is a different tower and is named in the story so readers do not conflate them. The 1916 guard mention predates the 1917 build date; unexplained. Elevation differs slightly between sources.
